purpose: In-game lag card, step 1: a MEASUREMENT with zero tries. One minute candles of both moneyline markets and four low spread strikes for each NBA, NHL and NFL game of a fixed list (closes 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-11). No trade is scored.
heldout: none (a measurement of quote timing; no settlement result is read and no rule is scored). The spread markets are also the unread sample of W-SPREAD-CELL1: the reader uses in-play candles only and prints no pre-game price and no outcome.
notes: One batched request per game, 3 to 6 tickers, about 4 to 5 hours of 1 minute candles ending at the market's close. ONE run, one answer: this job replaces the 35 request version and is not to be rebuilt on a longer list. The batched candle endpoint has not been seen to answer for sports markets; if the first three requests fail the run stops by the script's own rule. RETIRED Nov 12, 2026: one 215 request job of 1 minute candles risked the 200 MB a run size cap (SPREADCELL1 hit it). Replaced by INGAMELAG_M1A and INGAMELAG_M1B, the same fixed list of 215 games split in two, one redundant moneyline ticker dropped per game. Removed from the workflow choices.
